thoughts.en: A small model rated the connections by surprise: F49 5/5, F50 5/5, F51 5/5, F12 2/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5. An estimate, not a measurement.

thoughts.sr: Vidim podelu, a ne ujednačeno kretanje koje je Skeptic odbacio: maksimum PM10 promenio se sa 46 na 62, dok se NO2 promenio sa 33 na 31, a PM2.5 sa 13 na 12 u istom poređenju označenog sata. Trenutne prostorne krajnje tačke smeštaju PM10 na Omladinskih brigada, a NO2 na Pančevo Cara Dušana, dok je Krnjača donja krajnja tačka i za NO2 i za PM2.5. [F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: I see a split rather than the uniform movement Skeptic rejected: the PM10 maximum changed 46 to 62, while NO2 changed 33 to 31 and PM2.5 13 to 12 in the same labelled-hour comparison [F5] [F7] [F9]. The current spatial endpoints place PM10 at Omladinskih brigada and NO2 at Pančevo Cara Dušana, with Krnjača the low endpoint for both NO2 and PM2.5 [F4] [F6] [F8].
hypotheses: The opposite movements may mark a particulate pattern distinct from the gaseous and fine-particle fields; compare the next labelled hour across Omladinskih brigada, Pančevo Cara Dušana, and Krnjača [F5] [F7] [F9].
questions: Do the next SEPA values preserve this split between PM10, NO2, and PM2.5? [F5] [F7] [F9]
hypotheses_sr: Suprotna kretanja mogu označavati obrazac čestica različit od gasovitih i finih čestičnih polja; uporediti sledeći označeni sat na Omladinskih brigada, Pančevo Cara Dušana i Krnjača [F5] [F7] [F9].
